import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
EXPORT_ROOT = Path('/srv/chat/exports')
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path('/srv/chat/archive')

def _old_files(folder, max_age_days):
    cutoff = time.time() - max_age_days * 86400
    return [p for p in folder.rglob('*.json') if p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff]

def archive_old_channel_logs(channel_name: str, max_age_days: int) -> int:
    src = EXPORT_ROOT / channel_name
    dest = ARCHIVE_ROOT / channel_name
    # Flush pending export writes before archiving
    subprocess.run(['sync'], check=False)
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    files = _old_files(src, max_age_days)
    for f in files:
        shutil.move(str(f), str(dest / f.name))
    for d in sorted(src.rglob('*'), reverse=True):
        if d.is_dir() and (not any(d.iterdir())):
            d.rmdir()
    return len(files)
